title: Dumbbell Bench Press
summary: A flat press with dumbbells that gives a deeper chest stretch than a barbell.

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for chest (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly chest total.
Library rating 0.5 for front delts (helper): each working set adds 0.5 of a set to the weekly front delts total.
Library rating 0.4 for triceps (helper): each working set adds 0.4 of a set to the weekly triceps total.

setup.text: Sit with the dumbbells on your thighs, then lie back and bring them to your chest.
Pull your shoulder blades back and plant your feet.
Press up and slightly in until your arms are straight, without banging the dumbbells together.
Lower slowly until you feel a stretch across your chest.

form_cues.cue: Lower until the dumbbells are level with your chest
Use the full range. The deep stretch at the bottom is the main reason to choose dumbbells.

mistakes.text: Cutting the range short at the bottom to move heavier dumbbells.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds up to 2 ramp-up sets only when the load is heavy for the equipment and the main muscle is not warm yet.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 7.5% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 8-12 reps, stopping about 3 reps short of failure (RIR 3). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train comfortably.
